import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static char[][] a = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] b = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int[][][] id = new int[MAXT][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int cnt = 1;
    
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge next, rev;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
            this.next = null;
            this.rev = null;
        }
    }
    
    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        ArrayList<Edge>[] head;
        int[] d, pt;
        
        Dinic(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            head = new ArrayList[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) head[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            d = new int[N];
            pt = new int[N];
        }
        
        void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u == v) return;
            Edge e1 = new Edge(u, v, cap);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(v, u, 0);
            e1.rev = e2;
            e2.rev = e1;
            head[u].add(e1);
            head[v].add(e2);
        }
        
        boolean bfs(int S, int T) {
            Arrays.fill(d, N+1);
            d[S] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == T) break;
                for (Edge e : head[u]) {
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
                        d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[T] != N+1;
        }
        
        long dfs(int u, int T, long flow) {
            if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = pt[u]; i < head[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge e = head[u].get(i);
                Edge oe = e.rev;
                if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
                    long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                    long pushed = dfs(e.v, T, amt);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        oe.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
                pt[u] = i + 1;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long max_flow(int S, int T) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(S, T)) {
                Arrays.fill(pt, 0);
                long flow;
                while ((flow = dfs(S, T, INF)) > 0)
                    total += flow;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int[] row : dist) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) a[i][j] = s.charAt(j-1);
        }
        for (int time = 0; time <= t+1; time++)
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                    id[time][i][j] = cnt++;
        int source = 0, sink = cnt;
        cnt++;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) b[i][j] = s.charAt(j-1);
        }
        
        // BFS from 'Z'
        Deque<int[]> dq = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    dq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                }
        while (!dq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = dq.pollFirst();
            int uy = cur[0], ux = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int vy = uy + dir[d][0], vx = ux + dir[d][1];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && a[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dist[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dist[vy][vx] = dist[uy][ux] + 1;
                    dq.add(new int[]{vy, vx});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (dist[i][j] == -1 || dist[i][j] > t) dist[i][j] = INF;
        
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(cnt);
        // source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                if (a[i][j] >= '1' && a[i][j] <= '9')
                    dinic.add_edge(source, id[0][i][j], a[i][j]-'0');
        
        // time edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Y' || a[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int vy = i + dir[d][0], vx = j + dir[d][1];
                    if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && a[vy][vx] != 'Y' && a[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                        for (int x = 0; x < t; x++) {
                            if (dist[vy][vx] >= x+1 && dist[i][j] > x)
                                dinic.add_edge(id[x][i][j], id[x+1][vy][vx], 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        
        // sink edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Y' || a[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (b[i][j] >= '1' && b[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int cap = b[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int x = 0; x <= t; x++)
                        dinic.add_edge(id[x][i][j], id[t+1][i][j], cap);
                    dinic.add_edge(id[t+1][i][j], sink, cap);
                }
            }
        
        System.out.println(dinic.max_flow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
